articles.headline: The next phase of the obesity drug race
articles.summary: Five years after Wegovy’s FDA approval, the obesity drug market has evolved rapidly. Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly introduced GLP-1 pills to compete with the in-demand weight loss shots. Eli Lilly’s next-generation treatment retatrutide produced an average 28% body weight loss in clinical trials, the most ever seen from a weight loss drug. With Pfizer, Amgen, and Zealand Pharma developing new treatments, the weight loss market competition continues to grow rapidly to meet demand.
